hotspots.title: AfD party congress protests
hotspots.blurb: Germany's AfD party congress in Erfurt has sparked massive protests, with tens of thousands expected to demonstrate against the far-right party. Authorities are bracing for potential clashes, while AfD leaders seek re-election amid internal debates on extremism.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the high-stakes confrontation between far-right politics and widespread public opposition, framed as a moral and democratic crisis.

hotspots.title: PP-Vox coalition in Andalusia
hotspots.blurb: Spain's conservative PP and far-right Vox have formed a coalition government in Andalusia, marking the first time Vox has entered a regional government. The deal includes controversial policies like 'priority national' for public services and has sparked widespread criticism.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the normalization of far-right politics in mainstream governance, framed as a moral and democratic backslide.
